verdict.rationale: Lithic documents dated API versioning via the `api-version` header, letting users pin and control when changes reach their integration (lithic-docs-7, lithic-docs-19), which addresses versioning. However, there is no explicit documented deprecation policy (timelines, sunset notices, migration guides) for old versions. Missing for 10: explicit deprecation policy/timeline documentation, sunset notice process, independent corroboration of version support duration.
